name: p07-negative-judgement-no-cause
proposal: V13-10 a refusal or held verdict carries its cause
open_question: Should a negative judgement (a refusal) be required to cite at least one item it rests on, so a bare 'deny' cannot be released?
description: A model decision refuses a request, by judgement, and cites no evidence at all.

expected_under_02.rests_on: Sections 4.3 steps 1-3; -01 open point I-3 (empty evidence passes step 2)

proposed: Not released: a negative result reached by judgement with no evidence would fail a new requirement (step 2 FAIL, state refused), or a policy could list result values that need evidence. A mechanical rule's refusal already carries its cause, because the rule and its inputs are in the record.
status: PROPOSAL: not draft text. For discussion at IETF 127.
